summary.zh: 信德哈拉帕聚落；Mackay 1935–36 发掘、1943 年美国东方学会报告；以珠作/金属等手工业著称；上层有朱卡尔文化层。
summary.en: Sindh Harappan settlement; Mackay 1935–36 excavation published 1943 (AOS); noted for bead/metal craft production; later Jhukar occupation in upper levels.
